name: publication
label: Publication
css: .style-publication { background-color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--text, #0A1829); font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 32px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; box-sizing: border-box; overflow: hidden; } .style-publication::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #A855F7) 0%, transparent 40%); opacity: 0.06; pointer-events: none; mix-blend-mode: multiply; } .style-publication .hook { font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -1px; margin: 0; padding-top: 24px; position: relative; z-index: 1; word-break: break-word; } .style-publication .text { font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin: 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 90%; word-break: break-word; } .style-publication .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; opacity: 0.08; color: var(--text, #0A1829); z-index: 0; letter-spacing: -2px; } .style-publication .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text, #0A1829); opacity: 0.6; z-index: 1; } .slide-code.style-publication { background-color: var(--secondary, #0A1829); color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-code.style-publication .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #A855F7); } .slide-code.style-publication .text { color: #E5E7EB; } .slide-code.style-publication .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #A855F7); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-code.style-publication .brand { color: #9CA3AF; } .slide-code.style-publication::before { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--slide-primary, #A855F7) 0%, transparent 40%); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-publication { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--secondary, #0A1829) 0%, #1F2937 100%); color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-insight.style-publication .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #A855F7); text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.2); } .slide-insight.style-publication .text { color: #F3F4F6; } .slide-insight.style-publication .insight-text { font-family: 'Nunito', sans-serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #FFFFFF; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin: 0; position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 85%; } .slide-insight.style-publication .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #A855F7); opacity: 0.2; } .slide-insight.style-publication .brand { color: #D1D5DB; } .slide-insight.style-publication::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, var(--slide-primary, #A855F7) 0%, transparent 50%); opacity: 0.08; }
